tool_config.name: lookup_property
tool_config.description: Find fictional Hearth properties and units from the landlord's words. Call first and whenever the location changes. Return choices and ask clarification unless a property AND unit are uniquely matched; never guess. Also returns the current bound draft.

request_body_schema.description: Validated parameters for this Hearth repair tool.

query.description: Property name supplied by the landlord. Use an empty string when no property was supplied; never invent one.

unit_label.description: Unit label supplied by the landlord, such as 4. Use an empty string if not yet supplied.

tool_config.name: check_open_jobs
tool_config.description: Read possible duplicate open or approved repairs for a verified unit and issue. Call before preparing a new draft or changing its location, issue, or category. Duplicates must be explained and clarified, never silently ignored. Does not create a job.

request_body_schema.description: Validated parameters for this Hearth repair tool.

unit_id.description: Exact unit ID returned by a successful unambiguous lookup_property.

category.description: Repair trade supported by Hearth. Use the category that matches the issue.

issue_summary.description: Factual issue description from the landlord including room and fixture when known.

tool_config.name: lookup_maintenance_context
tool_config.description: Read actual maintenance history, repair policy, and contractors approved for a verified unit and trade. Only returned approved contractors may be used. Availability is not checked. Also returns the current bound draft.

request_body_schema.description: Validated parameters for this Hearth repair tool.

unit_id.description: Exact unit ID returned by a successful unambiguous lookup_property.

category.description: Repair trade supported by Hearth. Use the category that matches the issue.

tool_config.name: prepare_repair_draft
tool_config.description: Create a checked repair draft or apply a spoken correction to the SAME current draft. Never approves, sends a message, creates a work order, or confirms a booking. New: draft_id=null and expected_revision=0. Edit: use the latest returned ID/revision and only changed fields. Stale/cancelled/approved drafts must not be overwritten. Read the returned status before claiming success.

request_body_schema.description: Validated parameters for this Hearth repair tool.

draft_id.description: For a new draft only, null. Otherwise the exact current draft ID returned by Hearth; never choose another ID.

expected_revision.description: For a new draft only, 0. For an edit, the latest exact current draft revision returned by Hearth. Do not guess or auto-increment.

fields.description: Editable draft details only. For corrections, include only changed fields and preserve all unmentioned content.

property_id.description: Exact property ID from lookup_property; null only for an incomplete draft.

unit_id.description: Exact uniquely matched unit ID from lookup_property; null only when unresolved.

issue_summary.description: Repair issue as described by the landlord, including room/fixture when supplied.

category.description: Supported repair trade, or null if it needs clarification.

contractor_id.description: Exact ID from approved_contractors for this unit/trade. Null when unresolved; never invent approval.

preferred_date.description: Requested date only, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Null if not requested or explicitly removed. Never a confirmed booking.

access_notes.description: Landlord's actual access instructions. No inferred permission. Empty string only if none or explicitly removed.

contractor_message.description: Unsent contractor message draft using only checked facts. Omit on new creation to use Hearth's grounded message. During edits preserve existing text unless the landlord asks to change it.
